items.title: Bitcoin rebounds 17% from $55K lows as Nvidia rally sparks $500M crypto liquidations
items.desc: Bitcoin price upside hit $64,500 as risk assets surged on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, while crypto liquidations topped $500 million four hours.
